name: deus-commit-chart
description: Static GitHub contribution charts and local Git activity reports with README-safe SVG and interactive HTML output.

scripts.smoke: node generate-commit-chart.js --repo . --branch main --out /tmp/deus-commit-chart-smoke.html --title "Smoke chart" && node generate-commit-chart.js --repo . --branch main --format svg --days 90 --out /tmp/deus-commit-chart-smoke.svg --title "Smoke chart"
